These arrows are the weakest type of arrows in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'' and are compatible with most [[bows]]. As with most [[Arrow|arrows]], they can be [[Poison#Weapon poisoning|poisoned]]. In order to create this item players must first smelt [[bronze bar]]s. Then using a [[hammer]] and [[anvil]], the player must turn the bar into [[bronze arrowtips]]. Creating the bronze bar has no Smithing requirement, while a player must have level 5 [[Smithing]] to create the arrowheads. Then players should cut logs, and using a [[knife]], turn them into [[arrow shaft]]s. After attaching [[feather]]s to the arrow shafts (creating [[headless arrow]]s) players can then use the arrowheads on the headless arrows to create bronze arrows. This entire process requires level 1 [[Fletching]]. In addition, arrows can be purchased from a variety of [[General store|general]] and [[Archery shop|archery]] stores. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |version1 = Unpoisoned |version2 = Poison
